description: This Swift source file defines data structures and a class for managing watch notifications and inbox state in an Apple Watch extension. It handles message consumption, persistent storage, local notifications, and user interaction state.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: An observable class managing the state of the watch inbox, including message consumption, persistence, and notification handling.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes an incoming notification message, updates internal state, and triggers a local notification.

methods.name: restorePersistedState
methods.description: Restores the inbox state from persistent storage on initialization.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Encodes and saves current state to persistent storage.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a message based on its ID or content.

methods.name: ensureNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and requests notification permissions asynchronously.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps a risk level string to a corresponding haptic feedback type.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a reply draft for user interaction based on the current message and action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Marks that a reply is pending to be sent.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates the state after attempting to send a reply, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Creates and schedules a local notification on the watch, and plays haptic feedback based on risk.
